metadata.name: ad_pool
metadata.description: ad-pool — per-game ad slot auctions (SOL, per epoch) with moderated creatives for blockchain-games-hub

instructions.name: add_slot
docs: GameEntry.owner. Append-only.

instructions.name: approve_creative
docs: Moderator (Worker). First approval: full → Approved, text-only → TextOnly (A13).

accounts.name: moderator
docs: Worker key holding the Moderator role; pays the tx fee.

instructions.name: approve_image
docs: Moderator. Adds the image to a TextOnly creative → Approved.

accounts.name: moderator
docs: Worker key holding the Moderator role; pays the tx fee.

instructions.name: bid
docs: Outbid (refunds the previous leader in the same tx) or raise your own bid.
`amount` is the new total.

accounts.name: prev_bidder
docs: The current leader — refunded here. On a self-raise this is the bidder itself.
A stale leader (someone outbid first) fails with the retryable `LeaderChanged`.

instructions.name: close_auction
docs: Anyone, after epoch end + settle: closes the auction, everything left → rent_payer.

accounts.name: rent_payer
docs: Gets everything left in the escrow. Not a signer — funds can only go here, so
anyone may close.

instructions.name: init_ad_config
docs: GameEntry.owner of an Active game. One config per game.

accounts.name: game_owner
docs: `GameEntry.owner` — pays the rent of the config (D11).

instructions.name: open_auction
docs: First bid of (game, epoch, slot): creates the escrow, bidder pays its rent.

accounts.name: bidder
docs: Bids and pays the auction's rent (`rent_payer`).

accounts.name: config
docs: Source of the fee snapshot (rev 3 #7 · pc 03 §2.5).

instructions.name: reject_creative
docs: Moderator. Records a rejected submission; status unchanged (A8).

accounts.name: moderator
docs: Worker key holding the Moderator role; pays the tx fee.

instructions.name: revoke_creative
docs: Moderator. Takes an approved / text-only creative down → Empty (Q9).

accounts.name: moderator
docs: Worker key holding the Moderator role; pays the tx fee.

instructions.name: set_slot_active
docs: GameEntry.owner. `false` = no new auctions on this slot.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Anyone, after epoch start: fee → Treasury, rest → GameEntry.owner. No refund (D4).

accounts.name: game_entry
docs: Seeds come from the auction — never from an argument — so the GameEntry (and its
owner, the payee) of another game cannot be substituted. Status is NOT checked.

accounts.name: game_owner
docs: Revenue recipient = `GameEntry.owner` at settle time. UncheckedAccount (Q12): a
non-system-owned owner (multisig PDA…) must not make settle — and rent — stuck.

accounts.name: config
docs: Needed only for `treasury_bump`.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: platform-core Treasury PDA — must be pinned (pc 03 §2.6), else anyone could
redirect the fee.

instructions.name: update_ad_config
docs: GameEntry.owner. `None` keeps the current value; genesis/duration are immutable.

types.name: AdCreative
docs: Image + text + click URL (A10).
⚠️ Must match `platform_core::AdCreative` field-for-field, including every `max_len`
(bytes, not characters) — the FE renders both with one renderer (pc 01 §7).
`#[max_len]` only sizes the account; lengths are enforced with `require!` in the ix.

fields.name: image_url
docs: R2 object URL (`ads/<sha256>.<ext>`). Empty while `TextOnly`.

fields.name: image_sha256
docs: FE must check the fetched image hashes to this. All zeros while `TextOnly`.

fields.name: text
docs: Fallback shown instead of the image (A13).

types.name: AdSlotAuction
docs: PDA `[AD_SLOT_SEED, game_program, epoch.to_le_bytes(), &[slot_index]]` — one per
(game, epoch, slot); state + escrow of the highest bid (design §3). 779 bytes.
Created by `open_auction` (the first bid), so there is always a leader.

fields.name: version
docs: offset 8

fields.name: bump
docs: offset 9

fields.name: creative_status
docs: offset 10 — memcmp-able.

fields.name: settled
docs: offset 11 — memcmp-able (crank finds unsettled auctions).

fields.name: slot_index
docs: offset 12 — duplicates the seed.

fields.name: game_program
docs: offset 13 — duplicates the seed.

fields.name: epoch
docs: offset 45 — duplicates the seed.

fields.name: width
docs: offset 53 — snapshot of slots[slot_index].

fields.name: height
docs: offset 55

fields.name: close_ts
docs: offset 57 — epoch_start_ts − auction_close_lead_secs (snapshot).

fields.name: epoch_start_ts
docs: offset 65 — genesis_ts + epoch × epoch_duration_secs (snapshot).

fields.name: epoch_end_ts
docs: offset 73 — epoch_start_ts + epoch_duration_secs (snapshot).

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: offset 81 — PlatformConfig.ad_fee_bps at open_auction (rev 3 #7).

fields.name: min_increment_bps
docs: offset 83 — snapshot.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: offset 85 — the first bidder; gets the rent back on close (D11). Fixed offset.

fields.name: highest_bidder
docs: offset 117 — never empty (account is born with a bid).

fields.name: highest_bid
docs: offset 149 — winning amount; held in escrow until settle, history after.

fields.name: bid_count
docs: offset 157

fields.name: reject_count
docs: offset 161

fields.name: last_reject_flags
docs: offset 163 — bitmask of the latest reject/revoke reason (design §7.3).

fields.name: approved_at
docs: offset 167 — last approve time; 0 = none (reset by revoke).

fields.name: updated_at
docs: offset 175

fields.name: _reserved
docs: offset 183 — before `creative` so every fixed field keeps a fixed offset.

fields.name: creative
docs: offset 215 — variable length (max 564).

types.name: AdSlotSpec
docs: One ad slot of a game (5 bytes).

fields.name: active
docs: false = no new auction for this slot (existing ones continue).

types.name: AdSlotSpecInput
docs: Instruction input for one slot (tuples are not supported by the Anchor IDL).

fields.name: refunded
docs: Lamports returned to rent_payer.

fields.name: amount
docs: New total bid.

fields.name: refunded_to
docs: Previous leader refunded in the same tx (None on first bid / self-raise).

fields.name: moderator
docs: Signer holding platform-core's Moderator role.

fields.name: image_reject_flags
docs: Non-zero only for a text-only approval whose image was rejected.

types.name: CreativeStatus
docs: What the FE may show for an auction (design §4.1). Time-based phases are NOT stored —
they are computed from `Clock` (`math::phase`).
⚠️ Never reorder. INVARIANT: every explicit value == its variant index (the IDL carries
no discriminant values; `declare_program!` consumers encode the index). Append only.
Guarded by tests/test_layout.rs.

types.name: GameAdConfig
docs: PDA `[AD_CONFIG_SEED, game_program]` — one per game (design §2). 199 bytes.
Created by `GameEntry.owner`; there is no owner/revenue field here (rev 3 #4).

fields.name: version
docs: offset 8

fields.name: bump
docs: offset 9

fields.name: slot_count
docs: offset 10 — slots in use (≤ MAX_SLOTS).

fields.name: game_program
docs: offset 11 — duplicates the seed.

fields.name: genesis_ts
docs: offset 43 — start of epoch 0; immutable; multiple of 86,400 (Q7).

fields.name: epoch_duration_secs
docs: offset 51 — multiple of 86,400, ≤ MAX_EPOCH_DURATION_SECS; immutable (design §4.4).

fields.name: auction_close_lead_secs
docs: offset 59 — ≥ MIN_CLOSE_LEAD_SECS (D5); snapshot into each new auction.

fields.name: min_bid
docs: offset 67 — lamports (A12); ≥ min_bid_floor.

fields.name: min_increment_bps
docs: offset 75 — 1..=10,000; snapshot into each new auction.

fields.name: bid_horizon_epochs
docs: offset 77 — ≥ 1; × duration ≤ MAX_HORIZON_SECS.

fields.name: slots
docs: offset 79 — fixed array (not Vec) so every offset stays constant. Append-only.

fields.name: created_at
docs: offset 119

fields.name: updated_at
docs: offset 127

fields.name: _reserved
docs: offset 135

types.name: GameEntry
docs: PDA `[GAME_SEED, game_program]`. Never closed (I4) — only `Suspended`.
Layout: specs/designs/01 §4 (220 bytes).

types.name: GameStatus
docs: ⚠️ Never reorder — the relayer filters `GameEntry` with memcmp(offset 10, 0x00 = Active).
⚠️ INVARIANT: every explicit value MUST equal its variant index. The IDL carries no
discriminant values, so `declare_program!` consumers encode the *index*; a gap or
out-of-order value would silently desync them. Append only, next value = next index
(guarded by `enum_bytes_frozen_v1` + `enum_byte_equals_declaration_index` and the
compile-time `enum_tripwire` in tests/test_layout.rs).

types.name: PlatformConfig
docs: PDA `[CONFIG_SEED]` — single instance. Layout: specs/designs/01 §2 (97 bytes).
No `max_fee_bps` (X1 — ceiling is `MAX_FEE_BPS` in code), no `treasury`
(X2 — derive from `TREASURY_SEED`), no `moderator` (rev 3 #5 — RBAC role).

types.name: Role
docs: ⚠️ Never reorder — `role as u8` is a PDA seed.
⚠️ INVARIANT: every explicit value MUST equal its variant index. The IDL carries no
discriminant values, so `declare_program!` consumers encode the *index*; a gap or
out-of-order value would silently desync them. Append only, next value = next index
(guarded by `enum_bytes_frozen_v1` + `enum_byte_equals_declaration_index` and the
compile-time `enum_tripwire` in tests/test_layout.rs).

types.name: RoleMember
docs: PDA `[ROLE_SEED, &[role as u8], member]`. Existing = has role; closed = revoked.
EVM analogue: OZ `AccessControl` `mapping(bytes32 => mapping(address => bool))`.
Layout: specs/designs/01 §3 (115 bytes).

fields.name: winner
docs: Winner and winning amount — kept in the event because the account is closed later.

constants.name: ACCOUNT_VERSION
docs: Layout version written into byte 8 of every account at `init`.

constants.name: AD_CONFIG_SEED
docs: `[AD_CONFIG_SEED, game_program]`

constants.name: AD_IMAGE_URL_MAX_LEN
docs: `AdCreative` limits in BYTES (Thai ≈ 3 bytes per character).
⚠️ Must equal platform-core's (pc 01 §7) — value AND type (u16) — shared FE renderer.

constants.name: AD_SLOT_AUCTION_SIZE
docs: `AdSlotAuction` data size (discriminator included, creative fully reserved).

constants.name: AD_SLOT_SEED
docs: `[AD_SLOT_SEED, game_program, epoch.to_le_bytes(), &[slot_index]]`

constants.name: CREATIVE_OFFSET
docs: `AdSlotAuction.creative` (start of the variable-length tail).

constants.name: CREATIVE_STATUS_OFFSET
docs: `AdSlotAuction.creative_status` (u8: 0 Empty · 1 TextOnly · 2 Approved).

constants.name: GAME_AD_CONFIG_SIZE
docs: `GameAdConfig` data size (discriminator included). u32 like the offsets (TS `dataSize`).
Tied to `INIT_SPACE` by a compile-time assert in math.rs.

constants.name: MAX_EPOCH_DURATION_SECS
docs: Q11: cap on one epoch — bounds how long an auction's rent can stay locked.

constants.name: MAX_FEE_BPS
docs: Fee ceiling (C2). ad-pool re-checks the snapshot it takes from platform-core
and fails closed above it (design §5.3).

constants.name: MAX_HORIZON_SECS
docs: Q11: cap on `bid_horizon_epochs × epoch_duration_secs`.

constants.name: MAX_SLOTS
docs: Fixed length of `GameAdConfig.slots`.

constants.name: MIN_CLOSE_LEAD_SECS
docs: D5: bidding closes at least 7 days before an epoch starts.

constants.name: RENT_PAYER_OFFSET
docs: `AdSlotAuction.rent_payer` (Pubkey).

constants.name: SETTLED_OFFSET
docs: `AdSlotAuction.settled` (bool) — crank finds unsettled auctions with byte 0x00.
